lines.english: "Yo, Haruki. You look real sleepy."
"Same goes for you…"
Five minutes before the first bell, the two of us exchange somewhat drowsy morning greetings, both with bloodshot eyes.
"I barely got two hours of sleep last night… I assume you got about the same, yeah?"
"Y-Yeah…"
Though in my case, the reason for my insomnia was the long phone call late last night, and the excitement I felt as a result of the details of the conversation…
"So, how are you faring? I'm making pretty good progress myself. I think I'll have something to show off by tomorrow at this pace."
"That soon? I never imagined you would be so serious about it…"
"Well, after seeing you guys work so hard…"
"Takeya…"
"I'm not going to take it easy just because I've taken a backseat role.
I'll do all I can from the background. Even if it means I'm just a shadow…"
"The truth is you just really can't get over it, isn't it?"
"Well, putting that aside, you can trust me with this. At the very least, I'm confident that this is coming along better than the guitar."
"Please don't force reality onto me…"
In the end, even though I kept plucking at the strings until morning without sleep, I never felt that I made any progress at all.
"Still, though…"
With the way things are going, I wonder if Touma's words, "Kitahara can do it," will come true.
"That's unusual. Touma's not with you today?"
"And when exactly were we together!?"
"Thursday and Friday, last week. All the way from the station to school, you were walking a mere three steps behind her, weren't ya?"
"…You sneaky little…"

Thoughts like, "If you were watching us, you could have called out" or "Why do you care so much when it comes to women?" are both at the tip of my tongue, but saying anything would be stirring up the hornet's nest.
"If you'd simply walked next to her, I wouldn't have paid so much attention."
That's a lie. No way. I doubt it.
"…I must never tread in the shadow of my master."
"Your master, huh…"
"Yeah, what about it? I just genuinely respect Touma's skills…!"
"Don't take it so seriously. Don't worry, I didn't tell anyone. Especially not Setsuna-chan."
"Ah, don't worry about that. That's already been taken care of."
"…You sneaky little…"
"You planned to have me buy you lunch in exchange for your silence, didn't you?"
"The way you keep all your bases covered is just impeccable. Maybe I'm underestimating you after all."
"Ha-ha-ha… don't take me too lightly!"
Even Takeya couldn't have guessed that the girls had already discussed it, and that the one who gave me the idea for the solution was Touma herself.
…Huh, maybe it's no wonder that others underestimate me after all.
"Hey, Haruki…"
"Good morning, Haruki-kun!"
"Wha… owowowow!? Ow, ow, owwwaaagh!"
"…You two sure seem to be having fun this morning."
"Oh, hey, good morning…"
Right covered. Left covered. Front covered.
"Wha… hey, Haruki! Ugh, aaaaghh…"
Takeya's ears… All right, I've got them pinned between my chest and arms.
"…Setsuna."
"Why are you being so quiet?"
"Umm, well…"
I'd like to ask her, "Why are you being so loud?" in return…
"Agh, kgh, aagh…"
"…He's tapping out."
"You sure know a lot, Ogi…so Setsuna."
"Takahiro loves wrestling. He's always watching that stuff in the living room late at night."
Why is her facial expression completely detached from the friendly conversation…?
"I-I see…"
"Hmm… Fine, let's just start over."
"You sure know a lot, Setsuna."
"I just watched to make fun of it at first, but as it went on, I found that my palms were sweating because of how exciting it was!"
"I see… As usual, you're pretty uncool, Setsuna."
"Yup, just barely passed. Or should I say you were saved by the clock?"
"Bear with me until I get used to it… My life is being cut short in so many ways here."
"Ahahaha! All right, then, Haruki-kun. See you after school!"
"Yeah… Later."
Ogi..so Setsuna disappears from my view as I realize that the sight of her running along the hallway with her back facing me is actually quite dazzling.
All that's left is…
"Pfgahh! W-Why you…!"
"The bell rang, Takeya. Didn't you hear?"
"Of course I didn't! I'll remember this, Haruki!"
Frantically combing up his messy hair, Takeya also makes haste for his class.
"I see, so he didn't hear it… That's a relief."
The only person left in the hallway after the bell rang is the former class rep, who would be excused even if he ran a bit late on account of his track record.
"Well, it's only a matter of time before he finds out."
…As well as a former delinquent girl who couldn't care less even if she were a bit late.
"…How long were you listening?"
"Since you were at the shoe rack."
"You're joking, right?"
"What makes you say that?"
"Well, because…"
I want to think it's a lie. I want to think it's a joke…
Because if it isn't, everything that I just did in front of Setsuna would be…
"I am lying, though."
"So it was a lie!"
Class is only about to start, but I already feel the strength fading from my body. This week's off to such a great start…
"In truth, I started listening a bit before the "See you after school" part."
"Ah…"
"Haruki-kun, huh…?"
Just as I thought all power had left me, I tense up completely, my stomach twisting and turning.
Seriously, what a way to start the week…
"T-That was… well, I don't plan on making excuses. Umm, it's been like that since I got home last night…"
"Compensation for a certain incident?"
However…
"She was sulking so much yesterday. I was worried that she was going to start crying… She probably held it in until she had some time alone with you."
"Touma…?"
I'm all tensed up and nervous about it…
"I suppose it's all well and good. The princess seems to be in good spirits. I feel like the tribute you offered her is a bit too shabby, though."
"I'm just a simple commoner, after all…"
But she doesn't show the reaction that I was somewhat hoping for.
"Now then, let's get studying. The end-of-term finals are coming up soon… I get the feeling there's something else right before that, though."
From the beginning until the end, Touma had an astonishingly kind smile that was nothing like her, watching over Setsuna… and me.
"Hey, Touma."
"What?"
"The princess would also like you to pay the same tribute…"
"I must refuse, sir knight. For I am but a wandering musician. I wish not to be tied to any single country."
Which is why I end up feeling really relieved…
But there's still a strange feeling lingering in my chest; a prickling sensation, like a single thorn that hasn't been pulled out.
"Kitahara, here's the list of necessary materials. Motoyama said to send it to you for a review."
"Hey, Kitahara-kun, I've got a question about the basketball club's supplies. Do you have time after school today?"
"Hey, Haruki. About the popularity odds that came in today…"
"I told you all already… I can't afford to help anyone right now. I'm sorry, but try someone else."
"I know, I know. You just have to give it a quick glimpse… If you can really stop at that, that is."
"Come if you have the time… Everyone is waiting."
"You're the one who turned Miss Houjou High into a free-for-all. Take some responsibility, at least."
"Don't just focus on hitting my weak spots. You guys really are getting better at begging. Not to mention…"
"Okay, I know you're all excited because the festival's coming up, but the materials we're covering today will be in the exam. It's not my fault if you don't listen!"
"We're in the middle of class right now."
Since the festival's right at the end of this week, the atmosphere in the classroom has completely changed.
Only a small part of the class is actually paying attention to lectures. Everyone else is either texting, making plans for the festival with people around them, or just generally being too excited.
"What's the big deal? This is the last year we'll get to act like this."
"Even though you plan to fool around for another four years starting next year…"
"I'm telling you, it's just this week, jeez."
"And I'm telling you to at least pay attention during class."
"Like that?"
"Hmm?"
Saying that, Chikashi pointed right behind himself.
And indeed, I saw the figure of a student focusing and taking notes as if her life hinged on it, much like how I just described one should.
"No, something feels wrong there…"
"Sure does…"
Our resident sleeper… is, for once, not actually sleeping in class…
No, far from it, in fact.
…She's got a notebook, too.
"It's gotten so lively since the start of this week. Students from all classes are staying so late after school."
"That's just because they didn't prepare ahead of time and are panicking now."
"Ahaha… That definitely sounds like something you'd say, Haruki-kun. Are preparations for the contest all good?"
"Of course. My successor has been in charge of everything since last week… I hope."
"Huh? So you left the executive committee…? Is it because you got so tied up with the club?"
"…Well, something like that."
If anything, the real problem stems from suspicions regarding my close relationship with a certain candidate. But I wouldn't tell Setsuna that, even at gunpoint.
It's a good thing I left last week. If I'd stayed until this week, they probably would have kicked up a big fuss about it.
…Though right now I can't really exclude the possibility that they still might.
"Hey, speaking of which, what's Class E doing?"
"Your generic haunted house. What about Class A?"
"We came up with some weird name like 'Taisho Romance Cafe' or something…"
"…That one sure feels like it's trying too hard to be specific, doesn't it?"
"For some reason, the guys are doing their best sewing the uniforms. They're a lot more skilled with their fingers than I thought."
"I have a feeling they're just doing it to fulfill a messed up desire of theirs…"
"I'll be working at the cafe on Friday morning. Be sure to come and visit, okay?"
"All right. I'll come if I can."
I will. Absolutely. No matter what.
"Then, the three of us can go around the festival together starting in the afternoon. Oh, how about we go to your class's haunted house?"
"Eh? Uh, umm, well that's a little…"
"Oh, are you on duty from the afternoon?"
"No, Touma and I are both free all of Friday. But…"
Our haunted house is limited to couples only…
"I'd just like to get better at playing before then."
Yeah, that was a great follow-up… but not being able to go around the festival with Setsuna is a double-edged sword in itself.
"There's only five days left, huh…"
"Yeah…"
The games begin this Friday. And the showdown is on Saturday.
Putting aside whether desperately struggling will get anything done, it's all we can do within the span of five days.
"See you, then."
"Yeah."
Fifteen minutes on foot from school.
The two of us walked down a path that has recently become familiar to me, and arrived in front of the "Ogiso" nameplate.
"I'm sorry, Haruki-kun."
"For what?"
"Making you detour like this…"
"Well, a guy who wouldn't walk a girl home even when she's all by herself in the dark would be despicable, after all."
"J-Jeez, stop! I was just really out of it then."
This is my new path home starting from today.

Motivated by a desire to make things up to her, a slight worry and a self-righteous sense of responsibility, I offered to walk her home. I approached the situation fearlessly and like I had nothing to lose.
To make it easier for her to accept my offer during school lunch, I added conditions like, "if it's past 6 o'clock" and "at least until the school festival is over."

At first, a smile broke out on Setsuna's face for a moment. Afterward, however, she looked troubled due to her reservations and refused by shaking her hands and lowering her head, before finally nodding deeply.
"I told you not to worry about it. I'm seeing you home because I want to."
"…Really?"
"I don't think there's anyone who would mind seeing you home among us third-year guys, though…"
"I'm not interested in the opinion of an unspecified majority, though."
"I'm worried about you, Setsuna, so please let me walk you home every day… Does that work?"
"I'd say that's worth around 72 points."
"That's a pass, right?"
"…More or less."
What a strict grading standard.
"Well then, stay warm and get some sleep. It wouldn't be funny if our singer caught a cold now."
"Ah, yup. I know. I've been gargling my throat the moment I get home every day."
…Seriously, she's so adorable and ordinary about everything.
"Good night."
"Um, yeah…
Ah, wait a second!"
"Huh, okay?"
"You're going to Touma-san's place, right? …I mean, right now."
The moment I was about to smile, I felt like something suddenly pierced straight through me…
And then, I felt the blood draining from my face…
"…? Ah, wait… Don't get me wrong! J-Jeez! Why'd you turn so pale?"
"Eh? Ah… Did I get the wrong idea?"
Like what? In what way? To what extent?
"D-Don't respond in such a weird way… You're making me look like an overbearing girl who's desperately trying to keep her lover from leaving her for another woman!"
"Ha, ha, ha… Haha…"
I have to admit… those words really hurt. I don't even understand them, but they hurt.
…In particular, it's mainly my heart that's hurting right now.
"Like I said, that's not it. I just wanted to ask you to take some apples.
My relatives from Aomori sent some over yesterday. They're really sweet."
"A-Apples…?"
They're… really red.
"Look, Touma-san's living alone, so she probably doesn't get enough vitamins. Actually, I'm certain she doesn't."
"I suppose you're right there… She's a product of fast food, convenience store bentos, sugar, glucose, and syrup."
If we try to apply such a fact to what we usually see before us, however, it's really an eternal mystery as to how exactly she maintains that figure of hers…
"Wait here for just a bit, Haruki-kun. I'll be right back!"
"Eh? Ah, wait, Ogiso?"
"What did you just say!?"
"…I said Setsuna…"
"…All right, then. I'm home!"
"Ha, haha, haa…"
I'm so embarrassed in so many ways that I feel like I could melt any second now…
"Iwazu-chou, Iwazu-chou. Please mind the door when exiting."
"Whew…"
It's now 9:15 PM.
Since I'd spent fifteen minutes on each part of the round trip, I ended up coming to the Iwazu-chou Station platform about thirty minutes late.
There are just as many people flooding out of the train here as ever, each of them going their separate ways.
Following this scenery that has recently become familiar to me with my gaze, I start climbing the stairway leading to the north ticket gate…
This is a residential area where most people are getting off during night time, yet there's one person sitting on a bench waiting… and not for the train.
"Touma…"
"Hmm…?"
"The doors are closing. Please be careful."
"What are you…?"
"Studying. The exams are pretty close now."
"Look, you don't have to tell such an obvious lie…"
With that, Touma shuts the notebook that she had been enthusiastically writing in, and gets up as if nothing had happened.
"Well then, shall we head home?"
"Are you…"
"I'm studying."
And thus the question that I wanted to ask but was afraid to ended up being sealed away, as expected.
With the same, slightly wry smile from this morning, I walk by her side as always, but a little farther away than usual.
No matter how often I glance at her face from the side, she keeps looking straight ahead, and like always… no, this time it's a little colder than usual.
"Oh, yeah…"
"Hmm?"
"Here… Ogiso wanted us to split these."
"You can stop pretending."
"You mean…"
And there's another thing…
"…Setsuna wanted us to."
"Mhm."
It seems that even the act of passing her an apple has had a new rule imposed upon it.
"Perfect timing. I was getting hungry."
"Hey, is that seriously supposed to be your dinner? Start eating properly already."
"…This one's sour."
"Listen up. I know you're all excited because the school festival is close by, but the result of today's test will directly affect your final grade."
"Jeez, who in their right mind gives a pop quiz this time of the year…? What a sadist."
"That's why I kept telling you to at least pay attention to class…"
…Though I made a big deal of others to do it, even I can't help but hold my head seeing this reading comprehension quiz's long sentences.
Well, that said, I'm pretty sure I can still answer all of the questions.
Tuesday. Three days until the school festival. And four days until our decisive battle arrives.
The classroom's gotten a few more ornaments and decorations, too. In the restlessness of the entire school populace, the only one who remained the same is our guidance counselor.

A commotion broke out in the class for a bit as he abruptly announced a pop quiz. However, after realizing that any objection or opposition wouldn't change the situation, the class could only concede in silence.
"Ten minutes left. The trick to these long passages, you see, is to read the question first…"
Well, he's certainly enthusiastic about education, and his teaching style isn't bad at all. I'm not of the opinion that a teacher who's loved among their students is necessarily a good one, either.
It's just that, well… if he could just be more tactful about what's going on around him, he'd make it a bit easier for me to defend him as well.
With these thoughts in mind, I write down "4" in the space of the eighth, final question, and then check if my name and class are filled out.
All right, perfe…
"What the hell are you doing, Touma!?"
A sudden, loud shout right beside me nearly makes me drop my pencil.
…Truth be told, it wasn't the volume alone that startled me, but also the name that he yelled.
"You're supposed to be reading right now! What exactly is this!?"
Never mind this test, Touma hadn't spoken a word in class this whole week, only scribbling away enthusiastically with her pencil. For some reason, she has ended up becoming a target nevertheless.
"Not to mention we're in the middle of a test. Why are you always, always pulling these stunts!?"
"I apologize…"
"You don't feel sorry at all, do you? Where's your exam sheet?"
"Right here…"
"Look at this! You haven't even written anything besides your name! You weren't planning to do anything from the very beginning, were you?"
"I couldn't understand it at all. I'm sorry."
"Touma…?"
But…
Usually, she'd get annoyed by this point from talking back and being dismissive of him, but today, she's being unusually humble.

The way she's saying "I'm sorry" is completely different too. Even if it's only natural to accuse her of not doing it in good faith, she's honestly bowing her head, without even looking to the side or scowling.
"…W-Well, umm. If you don't understand the questions, it's multiple-choice, so you could just fill it in at random. But doing something else is just outrageous."
"I understand."
"Take your seat, and continue with your test."
Even Suwa seems to be baffled by Touma's commendable response.
Disappointed and slightly embarrassed, he turns the other way, and starts walking back to his podium.
"Umm, excuse me, Sensei."
"Hmm?"
Seeing this exchange makes me breathe a sigh of relief, and Touma's developing cooperativeness makes me somewhat happy.
"Could you… please return that? It's important…"
"Hmm? Oh, this notebook?"
Perhaps something changed inside her from sticking with me, or with Setsuna.
"I'm confiscating this. If you must have it back, come to the faculty room after school."
The thorns surrounding her from all around have shrunk, and bit by bit, the snow has melted ever so slightly.
"The rest of you, focus! We're still in the middle of a test here!"
"…Give…"
It would be wonderful if everyone could get to know the real Touma like this…
"Give it baaaack!"
"Touma!?"
But those convenient thoughts of mine…
"What do you mean, confiscated!? After school!? You think you have the right to take that away from me!? Don't screw with me!"
"T-T…Touma?"
…Are shattered in a matter of seconds, lost without a trace.
"Oh, no…! Stop, Tou… Uwaah!"
"Haruki!"
I try to hold Touma back as she snaps, but she dodges me with ease, as if she had eyes on her back.
…Thus, I end up spectacularly crashing into Chikashi's desk, given that my reflexes are average at best.
"Give it back."
"Ah… Hey, what are you…"
She does a feint on Suwa and easily snatches the notebook back, leaving both him and the whole class bewildered by the sudden turn of events.
For a moment, Touma holds it to her chest as if it were a treasure…
"Touma!"
She immediately calms down and checks the notebook that's back in her hands. Then, as if having completely lost interest in her surroundings, she nonchalantly leaves the classroom.
"What in the world…?"
All that's left is a commotion that would otherwise be unimaginable during a test…
About a third of our classmates' voices that I can overhear echoing in agreement with Touma, with the rest condemning her…
"I have absolutely no idea what goes on in her head…"
As well as Suwa-sensei's dumbfounded murmuring.
And as for me…
"I'm sorry! I'll come to apologize later. I'll write an apology letter, too. So umm… In any case, I'm really sorry!"
"Kitahara?"
"Umm… In any case, I truly apologize! Please excuse me!"
"Ah, hey, hold on!"
"Haruki…?"
Even though I've failed already, I desperately try to convince myself that I'm not too late to cover up for Touma's outburst.
"Touma…"
It's the middle of third period.
Music Room 2 is never used for lectures, so Touma's making good use of it as her hideout even though classes are still ongoing.
…Well, looking at the situation from this perspective, I can't say that I have absolutely no sympathy for Suwa's case.
"Stay away from me right now."
"There we go."
"I said stay away…"
But even so, in the end, I followed Touma like always.
Seated with the chair turned backward, I rest my elbows on its back and my chin on my elbows, listening to Touma's furious melody.
"Let's go apologize to him together after school. I'll think of what to put in the apology letters later, but you'll have to write your copy yourself."
And while I'm at it, I lecture her.
"And who asked you to do that?"
"Well, I asked myself. It would be fatal if you were to be suspended right now."
"Hmph…"
"Hey, what exactly were you writing…?"
"Don't mind it, it's just plain scribbling."
"I… see."
I'd like to ask, "Why go through that for just some scribbling…?"
But there's hesitation in my heart that I can't put into words, along with an inerasable sense of trust. In the end, I choose to stay silent and just remain by her side.
"Go back."
"Where?"
"What ever happened to never skipping class and always being on time?"
"That's not something for you to worry about, Touma."
"You might be held back a year, you know?"
"That's especially not something for you to worry about either, Touma."
As she usually does, Touma responds with an exasperated sigh.
By now, her furrowed eyebrows and her tense shoulders have slightly relaxed, and her fingertips have mostly calmed down too.
Although that might just be because she changed the melody.
"You must be bored listening to this, aren't you?"
"Not at all. I'm a fan of your piano playing, Touma."
Still, it couldn't have been the song alone that caused the tone of her voice to become gentler as well.
I want to believe that I helped out too, even if just a bit.
"The only side of my piano playing that you know about… is the pop music that I only play to mess around with you."
"If that's the case, then I'd love to listen to you playing some classical music in earnest, and not just messing around."
"It'll sound pretty boring to an amateur…"
"That's fine. It's a performance from the master, after all."
"Suit yourself…"
With a sarcastic smile, Touma's fingers jump about as if dancing.
Waves of sound with a variety of different emotions flow out, and slowly start enveloping me.
And only… me…
"Zzz…"
"Ow! W-Wha…?"
"Nice job falling asleep after bugging me so much with wanting to listen…"
"Eh? Uh, huh…?"
"And right in front of me, no less. How can you even fall asleep with such a loud noise so close?"
"Ah, well… how should I put it? Hearing you playing the piano really relaxes me, Touma."
Waves of sound with a variety of different emotions enveloped me as they flowed out…
There was something about it that felt so amazing. Yeah, no way that was boring at all.
…Is what I want to believe, but I can't really be sure.
"…I'm never letting you listen again."
"Even though I did my best and said such embarrassing things!?"
"Look, just go back to the classroom. And don't come back until after school."
"Well, see, I can't. Because…"
"Eh?"
"What's the password?"
"So this is that woman's house, huh…"
"Okay, I'm opening up."
"I texted Setsuna a while ago, and she said she just had to come…"
"I'm Ogiso Setsuna, from Class 3-A. I got out with a lie along the lines of, 'I have a headache, so I'm going to the infirmary'… Ehehe…"
"Is that something a school idol should be doing…?"
"And is this something the eternal class representative should be doing…? Here's your guitar."
"Thanks. You found the place easily?"
"Yup. Hayasaka-kun told me where the locker is."
"What are you guys doing…? Didn't fourth period just begin?"
For a moment, Touma spaced out as she watched the exchange between Setsuna and me, before the school bell snapped her out of it.
But that short window of opportunity was all we needed to hook the guitar up to the amp, turn the microphone on, and completely set up for practice.
"Listen, Touma. I don't think what you did was right whatsoever."
"But, you know, we're all in the same club. We're in it together, whether it be fun things, bad things, bothersome things… or even anger toward society, okay?"
"There are times when a man must rebel against his teachers, even if it looks bad on his report card."
"…You should come up with something a little more generic and cool, you know."
"Not to mention… Setsuna would be sulking again if I had kept quiet about something as fun as this."
"Well of course I would! We promised not to keep any more secrets, after all!"
Thus, rather than running after Touma alone, I decided to bring Setsuna along here with me.
Even if it's an "activity unbecoming of students" such as this one, the three of us have to act out together.
"…You two are going to be held back a year because you keep hanging around me, you know?"
"What are you saying? You've got it backward. You're the one that's going to graduate because you keep hanging around us."
"After the school festival is over, we'll tutor you personally, all right? I'm confident that I'm better at English than Haruki-kun is, at least."
"At any rate, our graduations and recommendations are pretty much guaranteed, so we'll be sticking with you through each and every supplementary exam you've got."
"…Are you guys stupid or something?"
"There's no one here quite as stupid as you are, Touma."
"Well, when it comes to grades, right?"
"Are you trying to cover for her?"
"Eh? Not really…?"
"…I'm getting a headache…"
Touma's response is as blunt, exasperated, and slightly cold as ever.
"With that out of the way, since we've all gathered here, let's practice until lunchtime… But let's try to be quiet about it, since classes are still running."
"Oh, that sounds great. Lunch is gonna be all the more delicious if I sing now!"
"…You really are stupid…"
But under that cynicism, and through her calm, wry smile, I sense the slightest bit of kindness blooming in her heart.
And so, for a short spell, and in obvious violation of school regulations…
…The three of us enjoy our rebellion without a cause to the fullest.
And naturally, all three of us got scolded afterward.
"…It's done."
"Haa… Fuuu… haah…"
"Haha…"
"Nghh… Hmm…?"
"I made it in time… Hahah… I guess I really am a genius, huh…?"
"Touma?"
"Ah, morning, Kitahara. You should get going or you'll be late."
"…Touma?"
"Ah…"
"Fuwaahhhh… What time is it now?"
"7:15. You stayed up past 6 AM this time."
"Did I…? Uuugh…"
I only slept for about an hour…? Well, that would explain why I hallucinated hearing Kazusa sounding strangely happy.
"You might be able to make it in time even if you take a shower right now."
"I'm good… I'll hurry to school and sleep until classes start. Just like you, Touma."
"Oh, I see."
"Actually, you should be the one taking a shower. And you should be hurrying too, or you'll be late."
Normally, she'd be done with showering by the time I wake up, but she's still wearing her plain clothes today.
"Ah, well, the thing is… I'm skipping today."
"Eh?"
"This week has been pretty busy, you know… I thought I should get some sleep today, at least."
"…I've been wondering since yesterday, what exactly have you been doing, Touma?"
Even though she usually sleeps off most classes to recover her energy, this week she's been staying awake writing something in a notebook, even during her precious sleep time.
She didn't even let up after school or at our practice sessions in the evenings. Even during break periods, she was muttering to herself, and just like she said, she's had no time to sleep at all.

The joyous eve of our reckless challenge.

Because I've seen her naive, frank, selfish, and mischievous sides, and even had her snap at me. To me, she's just a regular girl-next-door…
"That's why you have to decide carefully whether we'll perform tomorrow or not. You're the only one who can protect her now, after all…"

"Haruki?"
No matter how much Takeya worries about us, or how much sincere advice he gives me…

that's the whole idea of our shop, so I think it's fine."

"I expected no less prudence from you, Haruki-kun! I'm really relieved to see that you are your usual self… I'm so glad…"
"Setsuna…"

"I sincerely apologize for what I'm about to do, Class A. But…"

"Make way, coming through! Hey, don't be running there!"
